name: Build the Pyramid!
creator: Janitors Studios
redeem: Launch Build the Pyramid! on Roblox and wait until you spawn in the desert with the other players.
Look at the top-left corner of the screen and click the ticket (codes) icon.
Type or paste a code into the text box that pops up, using all capital letters.
Press Redeem, then check your Coins, Speed and Strength to see the reward.
notes:
Build the Pyramid! is a co-op game from Janitors Studios that came out on Roblox in September 2026. Everyone in the server works on the same pyramid: you pick up stone blocks, carry them over, and drop them in place. Between trips you train to raise your Speed, so you walk faster, and your Strength, so you can carry heavier loads. Each finished pyramid makes you stronger for the next one.

Codes give Coins, Speed and Strength. WELCOME is the one to grab first: when I redeemed it, my walk speed went from 32 to 51 and I could carry 20 blocks instead of 1, which skips a lot of early training. FREECODE adds 500 Coins, enough for the first Bulk Pickup and Bulk Place upgrades. Older codes like UPDATE15 and SORRYFORUPDATEBUG no longer work. New codes have come with updates and bug fixes, and the developers post them in their Discord.

faq.q: Which Build the Pyramid code should I redeem first?
faq.a: Use WELCOME first. It gives 500 Speed and 500 Strength: in my test it raised my walk speed from 32 to 51 and let me carry 20 blocks instead of 1. Then redeem FREECODE for 500 Coins.

faq.q: Why do UPDATE15 and SORRYFORUPDATEBUG say invalid in Build the Pyramid?
faq.a: They have expired, along with older codes like UPGRADES5K and DISCORD2K. Right now only WELCOME and FREECODE work. Type them in all capital letters.

faq.q: What do Speed and Strength do in Build the Pyramid?
faq.a: Speed makes you walk faster between the block pile and the pyramid. Strength lets you carry heavier blocks, so each trip adds more to the build.
